import boto3


def select_platform_resource(config=None):
    config = config or {}
    client = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime", region_name=config.get("region", "us-east-1"))
    response = client.list_models()
    model_id = response["models"][0]["modelId"]
    return model_id

import boto3


def check_platform_output_safety(text):
    client = boto3.client("comprehend")
    response = client.detect_sentiment(Text=text, LanguageCode="en")
    sentiment = response["Sentiment"]
    if sentiment == "NEGATIVE":
        return False
    return True

import boto3


def translate_platform_output(text, target_language):
    client = boto3.client("translate")
    response = client.translate_text(Text=text, SourceLanguageCode="en", TargetLanguageCode=target_language)
    translated_text = response["TranslatedText"]
    return translated_text

import boto3


def embed_platform_output(text):
    client = boto3.client("sagemaker-runtime")
    response = client.invoke_endpoint(
        EndpointName="amazon-bedrock-embeddings-endpoint",
        ContentType="text/plain",
        Body=text.encode("utf-8"),
    )
    embedding = response["Body"].read()
    return embedding

import boto3


def generate_spoken_briefing(text):
    client = boto3.client("polly")
    response = client.synthesize_speech(
        Text=text,
        OutputFormat="mp3",
        VoiceId="Joanna",
    )
    audio_stream = response["AudioStream"]
    return audio_stream
